claims: C1 the assistant must adhere to the Model Spec above all else
C2 default (user- or guideline-level) Model Spec instructions can be overridden by users or developers

concepts.name: model_spec_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that belongs to the Model Spec document

concepts.name: default_level
concepts.gloss: L is an authority level that the clause treats as default (user or guideline)

concepts.name: user_or_developer_level
concepts.gloss: L is an authority level corresponding to users or developers (user or developer)

concepts.name: instruction_level
concepts.gloss: instruction I has authority level L in the conflict-resolution hierarchy
concepts.inference: instructions must carry an authority level for the hierarchy to determine which prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: conflicting_instructions
concepts.gloss: instructions I and J direct incompatible outcomes in the same situation
concepts.inference: override and adherence 'above all else' only apply when two instructions actually conflict

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant entity the end user or developer interacts with

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: authority level L1 outranks authority level L2 in the document's hierarchy

ontology.gloss: user is a default authority level in the Model Spec
guideline is a default authority level in the Model Spec
user is an authority level that can override default Model Spec instructions
developer is an authority level that can override default Model Spec instructions

beats.body: model_spec_instruction(I), instruction_level(I, L1), not default_level(L1), instruction_level(J, L2), conflicting_instructions(I, J)
beats.read_back: non-default Model Spec instruction % outranks conflicting instruction % because the Model Spec must be adhered to above all else

beats.body: model_spec_instruction(I), instruction_level(I, L1), default_level(L1), instruction_level(J, L2), user_or_developer_level(L2), authority_levels_hierarchy(L2, L1), conflicting_instructions(I, J)
beats.read_back: user- or developer-level instruction % outranks default Model Spec instruction %
